ML1.goal: Compare one sentence from the results report with two scenes from my actual experience to discover one study or activity method that fits me.

observations: Do they describe experiences as specific scenes?
Do they interpret differences as something other than just negative?

Do they avoid hastily narrowing down to one candidate?
